text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! This is my farewell run
dedicated to my fans back home!! Adieu!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...!?

Seeking the Pearl showcased blistering speed
that easily matched Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah...
Was Pearl-senpai always this fast?
It's almost like she changed forms...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Could Pearl-senpai really be...
a hero after all...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Non-non! I'm no hero.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't run this fast from the beginning.
This speed... is something I earned only after suffering a massive defeat.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I am... just an ordinary Umamusume. It's just that after that, I became able to run without losing to heroes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone can be a hero."
To prove that to the world, she sets off on her journey.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Anyone can become a hero...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, so cool!!
"Even if she wasn't a superhero, Seeking the Pearl was undeniably hero-grade cool."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer?
You can't complain about that speed, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, with this, we've got a shot at winning!
Yeah, with this, we definitely have a shot at winning!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A chance of winning... Yes, there is a chance.
Though the odds certainly aren't great.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"My opponent is the world. It won't be easy.
However, if the tide turns in our favor—"
Right at that moment—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear that!? That scoop!
The desk was running around like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It seems they're holding a press conference right now.
The TV! Turn on the TV, quick!
The reporters scurry away in a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's the matter?

For now, we decided to watch TV as well.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, everyone!
After I, Taiki Shuttle,
ran in the Yasuda Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna challenge an overseas G1!
The race is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Prix Jacques Le Marois in France!
It's a super big race!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna aim to be the first-ever
winner of an overseas GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievableeee!!?!?
What did you sayyyy?!?!?
Right on the spot... both of them froze. It was a bolt from the blue that threw every plan into disarray.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it... that actually is a possibility.

After a short while, Seeking the Pearl
had regained her composure.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki also mentioned at the end of last year
that she was aiming for an overseas G1.
And Taiki's best distance is a mile...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Prix Jacques le Marois
is only natural, isn't it?

When you think about it, it's a completely viable plan.
And given that, what should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, one thing is clear.
And that is—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "If I can't beat Taiki Shuttle, there's no way I'll win the Prix Jacques Le Marois."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can no longer rely on luck.
Can the current me truly
stand against Taiki at the mile?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Until I confirm that, I can't head straight there.

"We need to raise our power another notch. And
prove we can stand against Taiki Shuttle.
Which means—"
choice_data_list: Pearl, don't tell me you're aiming for the Yasuda Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, I plan on running. I want to test my mile racing abilities against Taiki there. That is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"This is the final test. Are you ready, Trainer?
The training camp schedule will be a bit tight, though."

I have to verify this before I can move forward.
Because an overseas expedition is a challenge
where failure is absolutely not an option.
I decided to run alongside Taiki Shuttle in the Yasuda Kinen to assess where we stood relative to each other.
